title: Underlying geometric inverse image for an invertible structural ring map
statement: Let f be a geometric morphism of small ringed topoi with commutative sheaf rings R and S and invertible structural ring map. If P is any left adjoint of the specified induced module direct image f.modules, there is a natural isomorphism P followed by the underlying-sheaf functor to the geometric inverse image of underlying sheaves. Under this isomorphism the supplied module adjunction Hom equivalence is the supplied geometric Hom equivalence. The precise normalization is the Lean statement.

source.place: Tags 03D1--03D3, module inverse image and its adjunction; uniqueness of left adjoints.

proof.text: Lift the sectionwise commutative rings to commutative ring sheaves. Transport their additive and scalar operations through the invertible structural ring map. The geometric module construction and its algebraic inverse-image realization provide a module inverse image whose underlying sheaf functor is geometric inverse image. Construct its adjunction using the normalized geometric Hom equivalence. Uniqueness of left adjoints gives the natural isomorphism from P. The unit equation for the unique comparison proves the displayed normalization for every module map.

lean.statement:
theorem cartesianModulePullbackUnderlying
    {C D : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D]
    {K : GrothendieckTopology C} {L : GrothendieckTopology D}
    {R : Sheaf K RingCat.{u}} {S : Sheaf L RingCat.{u}}
    (hR : ∀ U (a b : R.obj.obj U), a * b = b * a)
    (hS : ∀ U (a b : S.obj.obj U), a * b = b * a)
    (f : RingedToposMorphism R S) [IsIso f.ringMap]
    (P : ringedSiteModules.{u} S ⥤ ringedSiteModules.{u} R) (adj : P ⊣ f.modules) :
    ∃ e : P ⋙ diagramCoefficientUnderlying R ≅ diagramCoefficientUnderlying S ⋙ f.inverse,
      ∀ M H (a : P.obj M ⟶ H),
        (diagramCoefficientUnderlying S).map (adj.homEquiv M H a) ≫ f.underlying.hom.app H =
          f.adj.homEquiv _ _ (e.inv.app M ≫ (diagramCoefficientUnderlying R).map a)
